PRIMARY_HYPOTHESIS: A leakage-safe starter block improves Brier, log loss, AUC, and probability RESOLUTION (Murphy resolution component) versus (a) raw V13 and (b) the identical estimator without starter features, on identical games under expanding date-ordered walk-forward.
resolution_is_reported_not_sufficient: V19 demonstrated wider probabilities can merely be more confident errors. Widening alone is NEVER success; improvement must appear in proper scoring (Brier, log loss), discrimination (AUC), and calibration TOGETHER.

ESTIMATOR_FROZEN.family: ridge logistic regression (the MLV2 estimator family, fold-discipline identical to the audited 8/10 build)
ESTIMATOR_FROZEN.walk_forward: expanding, date-ordered. Fold k trains on all slate dates strictly before date k, predicts date k. Minimum training window: 30 slate dates; earlier dates are burn-in, never scored.
ESTIMATOR_FROZEN.per_fold_fitting: standardization (train-moments only), ridge penalty (inner 80/20 split of the TRAINING window, grid lambda in {0.01,0.03,0.1,0.3,1,3,10}), coefficients — ALL inside the fold. Imputation: NONE in the primary vector; a row missing any primary feature is excluded (see missingness).
ESTIMATOR_FROZEN.seed: deterministic closed form — no RNG in the estimator

primary_vector: sp_shrunk_kbb_edge: [(k_pct - bb_pct) shrunk toward 13.5 with w=gs/(gs+8)] home minus away
sp_rest_days_edge: (slate_date - last_start_date) days, capped at 15, home minus away
sp_workload_ip30_edge: total IP in the trailing 30 days strictly before slate_date, from pitcher logs, home minus away
sp_exp_ip_edge: mean IP over last 5 starts shrunk toward 5.4 with w=n_starts/(n_starts+3), home minus away
park_factor (venue constant, present in BOTH arms — it is not team form)

exclusions_frozen.unshrunk_team_form: EXCLUDED from the primary vector (owner condition; OOF ablation shows harm)
exclusions_frozen.shrunk_team_form: NOT a retained feature. May appear ONLY as a named post-hoc ablation arm, reported separately, never merged into the primary result
exclusions_frozen.handedness: EXCLUDED — 0% coverage (pitchers.csv carries name/id only). Coverage rule: a feature enters only with >=90% coverage in the training window; recorded as failed-coverage, not silently dropped
exclusions_frozen.times_through_order: EXCLUDED — no TTO data in the repository; same coverage rule

FEATURES_FROZEN.no_feature_shopping: this list is closed. The fit runs ONCE against exactly this vector. Any variation is a NEW prereg.

LEAKAGE_RULES_FROZEN.feature_cutoff: every feature computed from data strictly before the slate date (the ml_asof firewall dataset's existing strict-prior guarantee, already enforced by its own gates)
LEAKAGE_RULES_FROZEN.starter_identity_limitation_DISCLOSED: historical rows carry starter_status=RESOLVED_POST_HOC — the actual starter, not an archived pregame probable. Using it assumes probable==actual, which 8/17 showed fails (Lowder G1/G2). This mild identity leakage is a FROZEN, DISCLOSED limitation of the development window; it cannot be repaired retroactively because pregame probables were not archived. The PROMOTION test is immune: it runs only on prospective forward games with starter_confirmed_pregame=true.
LEAKAGE_RULES_FROZEN.unknown_starter: BLOCKS the forecast for that game. League-average substitution may be displayed on a card for tracking but can NEVER produce a betting candidate and is excluded from V14 scoring entirely.

COMPARATORS_FROZEN_identical_games.name: raw_V13
COMPARATORS_FROZEN_identical_games.source: data/mlb/evaluations/v13_full_30k.jsonl (pinned historical replay, per-game seed, n=30000), joined on gamePk

COMPARATORS_FROZEN_identical_games.name: calibrated_V13
COMPARATORS_FROZEN_identical_games.method: Platt scaling of raw V13: logistic fit of y on logit(p_v13) over the SAME expanding training window per fold — refit each fold, never on scoring rows

COMPARATORS_FROZEN_identical_games.name: expanding_home_rate
COMPARATORS_FROZEN_identical_games.method: home-win base rate over all training dates in the fold

COMPARATORS_FROZEN_identical_games.name: no_starter_ablation
COMPARATORS_FROZEN_identical_games.method: identical ridge-logistic pipeline, feature vector = park_factor only

MISSINGNESS_FROZEN.row_eligibility: eligible_for_evaluation=true AND both sp blocks present AND both last_start_date present AND label present. Expected n~1255 over ~105 scored dates (of 108; first 30 are burn-in). Every exclusion counted and reported by reason; kept+excluded must reconcile to the dataset total.
MISSINGNESS_FROZEN.no_imputation_in_primary: a missing primary feature excludes the row; nothing is filled

CALIBRATION_METHOD_FROZEN: V14 raw outputs scored as-is (ridge logistic is natively probabilistic). Calibration ASSESSED via logistic recalibration fit (slope/intercept), 10 equal-count reliability bins, and Murphy decomposition (reliability/resolution/uncertainty). No output recalibration of V14 in this experiment.

PRACTICAL_EFFECT_THRESHOLDS_FROZEN.minimum_practical_improvement: 0.00068 Brier (25% of yardstick) vs the no-starter ablation
PRACTICAL_EFFECT_THRESHOLDS_FROZEN.development_signal: Holm-adjusted date-block bootstrap CI for dBrier vs no_starter_ablation excluding zero AND mean improvement >= 0.00068
PRACTICAL_EFFECT_THRESHOLDS_FROZEN.auc_requirement: V14 AUC > no_starter_ablation AUC and > raw V13 AUC, point estimates, with date-block bootstrap CI reported
PRACTICAL_EFFECT_THRESHOLDS_FROZEN.calibration_acceptable: recalibration slope in [0.80, 1.20] AND |intercept| <= 0.12 AND reliability component <= 0.004

INFERENCE_FROZEN: date-block bootstrap (resample slate dates with replacement, 10000 draws, seed 20260818) on paired per-date mean score differences; Holm across the comparison family {V14 vs raw_V13, V14 vs calibrated_V13, V14 vs expanding_home_rate, V14 vs no_starter_ablation} x {Brier, logloss} = 8 tests.
PROMOTION_CRITERIA_FROZEN_ALL_REQUIRED: >=500 PROSPECTIVE games across >=60 slate dates, forward-only, starter_confirmed_pregame=true on every scored game
Holm-adjusted paired date-block intervals favoring V14 over raw V13 AND over the no-starter ablation on Brier
